agentPayments.note: Paid through the abstract-account leash (scripts/leash.ts): the agent signed a MsgExecuteEVM meta-transaction and the owner relayed it; the chain checked spending rule billpay-agent (50,000 uqor per-tx, 500,000 uqor daily, executePayment only) before the call ran. No separate EVM tx hash — the EVM call executes inside the Cosmos tx, and the payment leaves no EVM log (eth_getLogs on block 10159020 returns nothing), so this entry is the only record of it in the demo. Schedule 1: 0.15/0.50 QOR, 3/10 payments after this.

leashRejection.attemptedCall: withdraw(uint256) with amount 1000 wei — outside the rule's allowlist, which permits only executePayment(uint256) on the guard contract
leashRejection.reason: a linked key with a spending rule may call 0xAc31FB4F4b85F29F6DC72e8485Fa9188b37f3B6E with data only if the rule lists the call in allowed_evm_calls (or lists the token as "erc20/0xAc31FB4F4b85F29F6DC72e8485Fa9188b37f3B6E" for a token transfer or approval): authenticator not permitted for this action
leashRejection.note: The relay transaction itself landed with code 0; the refusal is the abstractaccount_execution_failed event inside it. Schedule 1 (0.20/0.50 QOR, 4/10) and the owner's contract balance (0.10 QOR) were verified unchanged afterwards. Full record: deployments/leash-rejection.json. The failed attempt consumed authenticator nonce 1; the next leashed payment used nonce 2.
